caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a trivet or decorative metalwork piece. The object is primarily circular in shape, with an open lattice design featuring a prominent five-pointed star (pentagram) at the center, formed by intersecting straight lines. Surrounding the pentagram are partial circular segments that create additional open spaces, forming a geometric pattern within the round frame. Extending downward from the main circle is a short, narrow handle with a small heart-shaped cutout near its junction with the circle, and a circular ring at the end of the handle. The entire object is rendered in shades of dark gray to black, suggesting it is made of metal. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and the object is oriented so that its handle points downward. In the lower right area of the background, the name "Violet Martenstein" is written in small, neat text.
title: Trivet
